I posted the list in #strategic-pod. I found three Vantorre Group tickets, each with its source.

1. **#8841 (also written #PD-8841).** The sources contradict each other:
   - The 4/27 and 5/4 Moss digests have it open at Allentown.
   - Gideon says in #strategic-pod on 7/1 that he closed it.
   - The 9/30 Moss digest describes it as a new Newark ticket that Gideon escalated.
   - I can't see the ticket system, so the real status needs checking before the steering committee.
2. **INC-4821.** This is the Hartford incident ticket. The source is Gideon in #inc-vtg-hartford on 8/3.
3. **VT-55120.** This is the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. The source is Gideon in #inc-vtg-hartford on 10/14. I haven't opened it, so I can't confirm the attachments he mentions.

I left out #4812 (Vantorre Mobility) and #PD-4402 (Quillfeather). #PD-4418 is on "the account Nadia runs" but the digest doesn't name it, so I flagged it for her to confirm.

This only covers the three sources she named, so it isn't the full history from the ticketing system.
